description:
Cinematic 4k video of a man in a blue shirt sitting with two golden retrievers on a train station bench. One dog wears a blue vest, the other a red 'Birthday Boy' shirt. The man looks impatient until a vintage steam train arrives. He excitedly runs toward it with the dogs on leashes. Bright natural lighting, vibrant colors, and dynamic camera movement capture the busy platform and the man's expressive emotions.
